title: Studio 流程页头信息条：空间不够时整排缩成单字，改成按顺序逐个让位
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZeHNsF3RWcWpj7rGj

① product defect · Source: maintainer (Warren), 2026-11-23, UI review thread.
- 14:23Z 「还有哪些元数据可能会有问题？同时全面的测试 studio的各项功能」
- 15:09Z 「用fable 评审一下 studio的问题，提出修改方案」
- 15:23Z, decision card 「Studio 评审的 9 张卡，按 fable 方案立卡吗？」 → **「9 张全立」**

Evidence:
- Fable code review on main 9e0c0c23: project file `ui-review-2026-11-23/fable-studio-review.md`.
- Browser screenshots: `ui-review-2026-11-23/round2/`.
- Round-2 report: https://claude.ai/artifact/X5ukNAgphAq5vDpDAT6SAD

Paths are relative to `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/` unless they start with `ui/` or `packages/`. `SDS` = `studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx`. `zh` = `ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/zh.ts`. Line numbers are on 9e0c0c23.

## What (review r07, confirmed)
With the property panel open, the flow header's meta chips (status, trigger, on error, version, run as) all shrink to one character each. The meta slot takes whatever width is left once the header is 640 px wide (`studio-design/studio-tokens.ts:151`). `FlowMetaPills` lays its items on a grid whose columns can all shrink to zero (`metadata-admin/previews/FlowPreview.tsx:339`, from objectui#13135). The slot is then about 80 px.

## Expected
Items give way in order instead of all at once:
- Status and Trigger stay whole.
- When they do not fit, On error, version and Run as drop, starting from the end.
- When not even one item fits, the slot hides.
- The dropped items go in the row's hover text.

File: `FlowPreview.tsx` (`FlowMetaPills`, header variant).

## Acceptance
- A test pins the drop order and the hover text at three widths.
- Browser screenshots with the property panel open and closed.

Grading: `area:ux` · Bug · Cosmetic · builders, often ⇒ p2. Effort S–M. Evidence: read (review r07) + measured (`round2/` r07).

Dedupe: no open card names `FlowMetaPills`.
